verdict.rationale: Brex's evidence covers accounts payable only: AI-automated entry, approval and payment of incoming invoices, plus outbound vendor payments by ACH, wire and check. Nothing shows creating or sending branded outgoing invoices or collecting payment from customers. Invoicing is a fair question for a finance platform, so the axis applies, but AP bill-pay is an adjacent feature, not receivables invoicing.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can create and send branded invoices with built-in payment collection
